name: Transmission in Progress…
detailed_description:
Transmission in Progress is an innovative first-person time management murder mystery game, you will have to allocate your time between multiple different simultaneous events and use careful logic and deduction in order to unravel the truth of the case.

Playing as Inres, a forensic detective falsely accused of murder, you must cooperate with your former colleagues in an attempt to prove your innocence and determine the real culprit behind the murders.

As you are currently imprisoned, your investigation is quite limited, you will need to:

  • Eavesdrop to several different conversations happening live, and remain vigilant to any useful keywords you might hear.

  • Highlight any visible words in your environment, keep them accessible.

  • Find the relations between your inventory of words using your red string conspiracy board. 

  • Deduce the true culprit behind the murders and prove your innocence.

short_description: Transmission in Progress is a detective game located in a sound powered world, playing in the shoes of Inres, a forensic detective falsely accused of murder. You must tap into several different audio channels to determine the real suspect of the crimes you were falsely accused of.

content_descriptors.notes:
Transmission in Progress is a detective and murder mystery game, as such, it features written depictions of murder, injuries and violence.

None of these are visually displayed in the game, as they are purely text-based descriptions.
